mapper.select: SELECT EMAIL_ID, USER_ID, SUBJECT, CONTENT, RECEIVER_EMAIL, STATUS FROM EMAIL_RESERVATION WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId}
mapper.update: UPDATE EMAIL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = 'SENDING', UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId} AND STATUS = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE EMAIL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = 'SENT', SENT_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId} AND STATUS = 'SENDING'
UPDATE EMAIL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = 'FAILED', UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId} AND STATUS = 'SENDING'
UPDATE EMAIL_QUEUE SET STATUS = 'CONSUMED' WHERE QUEUE_ID = #{queueId} AND STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE EMAIL_QUEUE SET STATUS = 'FAILED' WHERE QUEUE_ID = #{queueId} AND STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMAIL_SEND_LOG ( EMAIL_ID, QUEUE_ID, STATUS, MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{emailId}, #{queueId}, #{status}, #{message} )
